site.name: Raafi Fajar
site.title: Frontend Developer & UI Designer
site.headline: Frontend Developer crafting fast, accessible, and beautiful web experiences.
site.description: Raafi Fajar is a frontend developer focused on building fast, accessible, and delightful web experiences with React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.

projects.title: Sportly
projects.description: A fitness tracking app designed to keep users motivated with clean, data-driven dashboards and a seamless workout logging flow.
details: Sportly helps people build consistent workout habits. The design focuses on reducing friction between opening the app and starting a session.
Key screens include a daily activity dashboard, workout logging with drag-to-reorder sets, and a progress overview with clear visual summaries.
The visual language uses bold typography, high contrast, and motion to celebrate every completed session.

projects.title: Payrole
projects.description: A payroll management platform that turns complex salary data into simple, readable dashboards for HR teams.
details: Payrole was built to make payroll less intimidating. The interface organizes employees, payslips, and tax summaries into a clear workspace.
The dashboard highlights what matters: pending reviews, payroll cycles, and anomalies — all visible at a glance.
Component-driven development kept the system consistent and easy to maintain across dozens of screens.

projects.title: Wepay
projects.description: A digital wallet concept focused on speed and trust, with a calm visual style and instant feedback on every action.
details: Wepay reimagines everyday payments with a minimal interface where balance, history, and actions fit on one screen.
Transaction flows are designed around quick taps: send, request, split bills, and top-up with clear confirmations.
The prototype was tested with real users to validate the flow before development.

projects.title: Estatery
projects.description: A property listing website that makes browsing homes feel effortless with strong imagery and fast filters.
details: Estatery focuses on discovery: search, filter, and compare properties without unnecessary clicks.
Each listing page balances rich photography with essential information, keeping the user in control.
Performance was a priority — images are optimized and the interface stays responsive on every device.

experiences.description: Building responsive web applications with React and Next.js, collaborating with designers to ship pixel-perfect interfaces.
Designed and developed landing pages and dashboards for small businesses, from wireframe to production.
Assisted in developing internal tools and learning industry best practices in modern JavaScript development.

educations.description: Focused on web and mobile development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, UI/UX fundamentals, and software engineering practices.
Continuously learning through certified courses in frontend development, algorithms, and UX design.
